metadata.question: Did Cambodia have more active fire during February than October from 2014 to 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use MODIS FireCCI51 or FIRMS active fire detections, 2014-2017, filter Cambodia by a simple interior point to avoid huge geometry (30K km² gives timeouts). 2. Masking: Active-fire collections are already confidence-masked; simply pick confidence class ≥ nominal 20 % (FireCCI variable 'confidence' ≥ 30) – no separate cloud / cloud-shadow step. 3. Logic: Count total number of active fire pixels (each pixel = one fire detection) inside Cambodia for the month of February and for the month of October across 2014-2017. Compare the two totals. 4. Recover from empty collection → C1; if counts are zero after masking → C2; if reducer returns None/NaN → C3; otherwise output A (Feb count > Oct count) or B (Feb ≤ Oct). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') cambodia = ee.Geometry.Point([104.9, 12.3]).buffer(80000) # ~20,000 km² interior polygon feb = ee.Filter.calendarRange(2, 2, 'month') oct = ee.Filter.calendarRange(10, 10, 'month') years = ee.Filter.calendarRange(2014, 2017, 'year') def fire_count(filter_month): col = (ee.ImageCollection('ESA_CCI/FireCCI/5_1') .filterBounds(cambodia) .filter(years).filter(filter_month)) n_img = col.size().getInfo() if n_img == 0: return None confident = col.select('Confidence').gte(30) # nominal 30+ = active total = confident.sum().reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=cambodia, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('Confidence').getInfo() return total feb_count = fire_count(feb) oct_count = fire_count(oct) print("Feb fires (2014-17):", feb_count) print("Oct fires (2014-17):", oct_count) if feb_count is None or oct_count is None: print("C1") elif feb_count > oct_count: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

cambodia = ee.Geometry.Point([104.9, 12.3]).buffer(80000)  # ~20,000 km² interior polygon
feb = ee.Filter.calendarRange(2, 2, 'month')
oct = ee.Filter.calendarRange(10, 10, 'month')
years = ee.Filter.calendarRange(2014, 2017, 'year')

def fire_count(filter_month):
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('ESA_CCI/FireCCI/5_1')
           .filterBounds(cambodia)
           .filter(years).filter(filter_month))
    n_img = col.size().getInfo()
    if n_img == 0:
        return None
    confident = col.select('Confidence').gte(30)  # nominal 30+ = active
    total = confident.sum().reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=cambodia, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('Confidence').getInfo()
    return total

feb_count = fire_count(feb)
oct_count = fire_count(oct)

print("Feb fires (2014-17):", feb_count)
print("Oct fires (2014-17):", oct_count)

if feb_count is None or oct_count is None:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif feb_count > oct_count:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
